title: The Ember Field
text: A field where one dragon fought another and the ground has never cooled. It still glows through cracks in the black crust, and the air above it shimmers. Dragon scales lie scattered among the embers like fallen leaves, some still smoking.

options.label: Gather scales among the embers, and mind where you step.

outcomes.text: The haul is good, though it costs burned fingers and boots that smell of smoke for a month.
The embers flare under your feet, as if the old fight still burns.

options.label: The sharpest reads the battle in the ground, to learn which dragon won.

outcomes.text: The ground shows which dragon won, and where it crawled off to heal. It is still there, still healing.

options.label: Go round the field, rather than walk where dragons died.

outcomes.text: The long way runs under a hot wind that bakes your armour dry and cracking.
The long way runs under a hot wind. At the field's edge lies a dragon scale, blown clear of the embers.
